fusions.name: Twin Threat
fusions.desc: A two-tined thrust that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Held at Length
fusions.desc: A thrust on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and pushes it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Both Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on 2 of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
